TOTKRecompAndroid

Pinned source: cc4f1346773b97ab799d49e2c0c3e1ebbb8318c8

The v143 fade conversion sites, cutscene entry markers and 200 ms cutscene
interval/present policy in runtime/game_patches_v143.c and the NVN pacing
adapter are adapted from tools/patches.py and runtime/nvn/objects.c.
The upstream code retains the LAS Recomp / SavageWindRecomp lineage and its
Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai notice. Native ARM64 veneers and integration with
this project's existing presenter are this project's implementation.
No Nintendo code or other Nintendo property is covered by this notice.
